title: Upgrade Babel tooling to 8
summary: Upgrade the coupled Babel parser, generator, and traverse development toolchain to the compatible 8.x line in one review track.
reason: Dependabot PRs #8, #9, and #10 update interdependent Babel packages independently, producing incomplete bot-only changes without repository change-control evidence. The related majors must resolve together while remaining separate from globals and ESLint majors.
behavior_before: Root WebView tooling resolved Babel parser, generator, traverse, and transitive helpers on 7.29.x.
behavior_after: Root WebView tooling resolves parser 8.0.4, generator 8.0.0, traverse 8.0.4, and their npm-selected Babel 8 transitive graph. Application runtime code and the separate Tauri package graph are unchanged.
manual_validation: OBSERVED: Babel 8 declares Node ^22.18 or >=24.11; root CI provisions Node 22 and local validation uses Node 24.15. The private-beta Node 20 job installs only apps/desktop/tauri/package-lock.json and does not consume root Babel tooling.
PASS: complete npm run webview:prework:check, including syntax, ESLint budget, generated WebView maps/contracts, DOM/routes/commands, and 282-script load order.
PASS: npm install resolved the coupled Babel 8 graph and npm audit reported zero vulnerabilities.
rollback_plan: Restore the three Babel 7 ranges in package.json and regenerate package-lock.json with npm install; do not hand-edit lock metadata.
notes:
This track intentionally groups only the mutually dependent Babel majors. It excludes globals 17 and the incompatible partial @eslint/js 10 update.
Upgrade the coupled Babel parser, generator, and traverse development ranges to 8.x.
Regenerate the complete coupled Babel 8 dependency graph with npm.
Refresh the package manifest summary after the coupled Babel 8 upgrade.
